news.title: Dow loses more than 500 points Friday as tech slumps and yields spike: Live updates
news.description: Stocks fell on Friday, bogged down by losses in technology stocks and a rise in U.S. Treasury yields.

news.title: Why Taiwan became the defining issue in the Trump-Xi talks
news.description: U.S. President Donald Trump had said arms sales to Taiwan would be on the agenda for his talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping which ended Friday.

news.title: Trump went big on tech stocks in first quarter of 2026, new filings show
news.description: Trump bought shares of Amazon, Meta, Oracle, Broadcom, Motorola and Dell worth millions, new ethics disclosure filings show.
